Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 3. This information was last revised in May 2024. Important Information on Usage: 4. This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. 5. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. 6. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. 7. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Uses: 8. Nystatin is used to treat fungal skin infections. How to Use: 9. This medication is for external use on the skin only. 10. Clean and thoroughly dry the affected area before application. 11. Apply the medication to the affected skin as directed by your doctor, typically 2 or 3 times daily. 12. The dosage and duration of treatment depend on the type of infection being treated. 13. Apply enough powder to lightly coat the affected area and some of the surrounding skin. 14. Wash your hands after applying the medication unless you are treating your hands. 15. Do not wrap, cover, or bandage the treated area unless instructed by your doctor. 16. Use this medication regularly to achieve the best results. 17. Continue using the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Side Effects: 18. Skin irritation or redness may occur. 19. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. 20. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. 21. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. 22. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. 23. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: 24. Before using nystatin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. 25. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. 26. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. 27. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: 28. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. 29. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 30. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: 31. This medication may be harmful if swallowed. 32. If someone has overdosed and has serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. 33. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. 34. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 35. Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: 36. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. 37. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose. 38. Use your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Storage: 39. Store this medication at room temperature. 40. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. 41. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Reminder: 42. This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. 43. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized medical advice.
